content.description:
Who We Are & Why Join Us

Avathon is the leading Industrial AI autonomy platform, helping customers across heavy industries -- energy, mining, manufacturing, aerospace, defense, and logistics -- accelerate the journey toward autonomous operations. Our platform is built on a Computational Knowledge Graph foundation that contextualizes and connects operational data across siloed systems, bringing together time series, structured, unstructured, and machine vision data to power AI-driven applications in asset performance management, supply chain intelligence, visual AI, and global trade management. With capabilities spanning digital twins, normal behavior modeling, natural language processing, and computer vision, Avathon delivers real-time predictive intelligence and agentic decision-making at industrial scale.

Cutting-Edge AI Innovation -- Join a team at the forefront of AI, developing groundbreaking solutions that shape the future. High-Growth Environment -- Thrive in a fast-scaling startup where agility, collaboration, and rapid professional growth are the norm. Meaningful Impact -- Work on AI-driven projects that drive real change across industries and improve lives.

Learn more at: avathon.com

Data Scientist – Forward Deployed Engineering

At Avathon, we build AI products that solve real industrial problems at scale. We believe the future of enterprise AI lies in small, focused, high-performance models - deeply grounded in domain context - not just large, generic systems.

We’re looking for a Data Scientist to join our Forward Deployed Engineering (FDE) team in Austin, TX or Pleasanton, CA. In this role, you’ll work directly with enterprise customers to adapt, fine-tune, and deploy Small Language Models (SLMs) and forecasting models on their own data, powering production-grade AI across logistics, planning, inventory, and demand forecasting.

What Makes This Role Unique

This is a customer-first data science role. You won’t just build models - you’ll make them work on real customer data and prove their value in the field. Working alongside forward deployed engineers, you turn Avathon’s graph and indexing systems into measurable outcomes for each customer, and bring what you learn back to our R&D and product teams.

What You’ll Do

Partner with customers to scope use cases, assess data quality, and define success metrics for pilots and production rollouts

Adapt and fine-tune SLMs/LLMs for customer use cases such as semantic search, forecasting, contract intelligence, and conversational insights, using PEFT, quantization, and efficient inference to balance performance, cost, and latency

Build forecasting and optimization models for demand, lead time, inventory, and planning decisions

Embed each customer’s supply chain knowledge into models by working closely with their domain experts and our product teams

Configure agentic workflows so AI Assistants can execute planning, optimization, and decision-support tasks in the customer’s environment

Work hands-on with real enterprise data - ERP, logistics, inventory, supplier, and contract datasets

Apply vector search and semantic reasoning to help customers navigate complex supply chain relationships

Work with FDE engineers to integrate models using custom Lambdas and our graph-based microservices architecture, and to deploy and monitor them on AWS, GCP, or Azure

Measure and improve quality, reducing hallucinations and improving reliability through continuous evaluation

Present results to customer stakeholders and feed field insights back to R&D, product, and engineering

What We’re Looking For

MS in computer science, data science, statistics, operations research, or a related field with 2–5 years of experience, or a PhD with 0–2 years

Hands-on experience with SLMs or LLMs (Mistral, Phi, Nemotron, Llama variants), including parameter-efficient fine-tuning (LoRA/QLoRA) for task-specific natural language query answering

Experience building Retrieval-Augmented Generation pipelines - document chunking, metadata filtering, hybrid (dense + sparse) retrieval, and model grounding

Experience with vector search, ideally FAISS-based indexes (IVF, HNSW, PQ), for semantic similarity search

Solid grounding in statistics, forecasting, and model evaluation

Solid hands-on skills in Python, PyTorch/TensorFlow, SQL, and vector databases

Experience taking at least one model from prototype to production

Comfort working directly with customers: running workshops, explaining tradeoffs, and handling ambiguity

Clear communication skills and a strong sense of ownership

Nice to have

Familiarity with Knowledge Graphs and Neo4j, plus GraphQL

Prior forward deployed, consulting, or customer-facing data science experience

Exposure to reinforcement learning, MARL, graph neural networks, or probabilistic modeling

Location, Travel & Compensation

Location: Austin, TX or Pleasanton, CA. Onsite five days a week when not at customer sites; candidates must be based in, or willing to relocate to, the Austin or San Francisco Bay Area

Travel: up to 30% to customer sites

Base salary range: $140,000 - $175,000

Why Avathon

You’ll work on core AI products, not experiments - solving complex supply chain problems for global enterprises, side by side with the customers who use them.

If you enjoy shipping AI that delivers measurable business value, this role is for you.

Avathon is an Equal Opportunity Employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, age, pregnancy, genetic information, disability, status as a protected veteran, or any other protected category under applicable federal, state, and local laws.

Avathon is committed to providing reasonable accommodations throughout the recruiting process. If you need a reasonable accommodation, please contact us to discuss how we can assist you.
